body.name: \(\mathfrak I_a^r(p,\omega)\) and \(\mathfrak I_{\Delta}^r(p,\omega)\)
body.construction: For \((p,\omega)\in\mathfrak D_+^r\), set \(m_j(p,\omega)=\ell_{d_j}+(u_{d_j}-\ell_{d_j})\omega_j/\pi_j\), \(\mu_D(p)=\sum_j\pi_jd_j\), \(\mu_Z(p)=\sum_j\pi_jz_j\), \(\sigma_D(p)^2=\sum_j\pi_j(d_j-\mu_D(p))^2\), and \(\sigma_Z(p)^2=\sum_j\pi_j(z_j-\mu_Z(p))^2\). Define \(s_j^{\mathrm{SDC}}(p)=(d_j-\mu_D(p),z_j-\mu_Z(p))'\) and \(s_j^{\mathrm{LEI}}(p)=((z_j-\mu_Z(p))/\sigma_Z(p),(d_j-\mu_D(p))/\sigma_D(p)-(z_j-\mu_Z(p))/\sigma_Z(p))'\). For each arm and branch, set \(c_a(p,\omega)=\sum_{j\in\mathcal O_a}\pi_jm_j(p,\omega)\), \(h_a^r(p,\omega)=\sum_{j\in\mathcal O_a}\pi_js_j^r(p)m_j(p,\omega)\), and \(\mathcal F_{a,b}^r(p,\omega)=\{x_a\in\prod_{j\in\mathcal M_a}[\ell_a,u_a]:b(h_a^r(p,\omega)+\sum_{j\in\mathcal M_a}\pi_js_j^r(p)x_{a,j})\ge0\text{ coordinatewise}\}\). Let \(\tau_{a,b}^r(p,\omega)\) be the maximum of \(\sum_{j\in\mathcal M_a}t_{a,j}\) over this polytope subject to \(0\le t_{a,j}\le x_{a,j}-\ell_a\) and \(t_{a,j}\le u_a-x_{a,j}\), with value \(-\infty\) for an empty polytope, and set \(\mathcal B_a^r(p,\omega)=\{b:\tau_{a,b}^r(p,\omega)>0\}\). Define \(L_{a,b}^r(p,\omega)\) and \(U_{a,b}^r(p,\omega)\) as the minimum and maximum of \(c_a(p,\omega)+\sum_{j\in\mathcal M_a}\pi_jx_{a,j}\) over \(\mathcal F_{a,b}^r(p,\omega)\). Finally, \(\mathfrak I_a^r(p,\omega)=\bigcup_{b\in\mathcal B_a^r(p,\omega)}[L_{a,b}^r(p,\omega),U_{a,b}^r(p,\omega)]\) and \(\mathfrak I_{\Delta}^r(p,\omega)=\bigcup_{b\in\mathcal B_d^r(p,\omega),\,h\in\mathcal B_e^r(p,\omega)}[L_{d,b}^r(p,\omega)-U_{e,h}^r(p,\omega),U_{d,b}^r(p,\omega)-L_{e,h}^r(p,\omega)]\). Both maps depend only on the primitive pair and fixed grid, and no ratio is formed outside the domain \(\pi_j>0\).
